tasks.task_description: Create reusable AI Gateway client wrapper
Design Claude Flow hive architecture using the gateway
Implement basic swarm with gateway integration
Document reusable patterns for other projects

description: Create Claude Flow hive and swarm using AI Gateway v2 with reusable architecture
context: Created reusable AI Gateway client wrapper with routing strategies, designed Claude Flow hive architecture with Agent and Hive classes, and implemented swarm with coordinator pattern. All components use the existing AI Gateway v2 for model routing.

Created comprehensive test suite for hive and swarm functionality, and documented reusable patterns for other projects. The architecture is now complete with gateway client abstraction, agent/hive collaboration, swarm coordination, and clear reusability guidelines.
